items.t: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
items.en: I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.
items.tl: Astawdiʿu llāha dīnaka, wa amānataka, wa khawātīma ʿamalik

items.t: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ مَا كُنْتَ
items.en: May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.
items.tl: Zawwadaka llāhu at-taqwā, wa ghafara dhanbaka, wa yassara laka l-khayra ḥaythu m kunt
